issues.title: Ingest Randolph County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $12,956,142 across 33 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($5,070,723), Road Fund ($2,887,788), Law Enforcement Center Fund ($1,522,214). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
